paite: Huan Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israel suan tengteng toh Shittim a pan akisuan ua, Jordan lui atung uhi. Agalkah ma un huai ah agiak uhi.
heading: Israel Mipite'n Jordan Akan Uh

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni thum nung in heutute'n giahphual ava tawn vialvial uhi.
"TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm leh siampute, Levi chite'n azawn uh na muh chiang un na omna ua kipan kisuan unla, na zui ding uh ahi.

Himahleh nou toh akal tehna tong sangnih vel ahi ding ahi. Naih kei unla, huchi in na paina ding lampi na theithei ding uhi. Hiai lampi lah tuma lam in na tawn ngei ngal kei ua," chi in mipite thu apia uhi.
Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kihihsiangthou un, zingchiang a TOUPA'N na lak ua thillamdang mahmah hih ding ahi," achi hi.
Joshua in siampute kiang ah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, mipite ma ah galkah un," achi hi. Huchi in thukhun bawm azawng ua, mipite ma ah apaita uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, “Mosi kiang a ka om bang in na kiang ah ka om ding, chih atheihtheihna ding un, tuni in Israel tengteng mitmuh in ka hon pahtawi pan ding hi.
heading: Joshua Kiang A TOUPA Thu

paite: Thukhun bawm zawng siampute, Jordan lui gei na tun chiang un, Jordan lui ah dingden un, chi in thu pia in,” achi hi.
Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu hong ngaikhia un," achi hi.
heading: Mipite Kiang A Joshua Thu

paite: Joshua in, "Hiai ah Pathian hing na lak uah a-om a, na ma uah Kanaante, Hitte, Hivte, Perizte, Girgaste, Amorte leh Jebuste adelhkhe ngeingei ding hi.
Ngai un, leitung pumpi TOUPA thukhun bawm in na ma uah Jordan lui akan hi.
Israel namte lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih sik in mi khat zel telkhia un.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA leitung pumpi TOUPA bawm zawng siampute khepek Jordan tui a akingaktak in, saklam a pan Jordan tui hong luangte akitat dia; ahong kiching venvon ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite Jordan lui kan dia apuanin ua kipan apawt lai un, mipite ma ah thukhun bawm zawng siampute apai uhi.
heading: Jordan Lui Kanna

paite: Bawm zawngte Jordan lui ava tung ua, bawm zawng siampute khe in tui gei asiktak in, buhlak sung teng Jordan lui a kuang tengteng ah tui alet gige hi.

Saklam a pan tuipi luang lai akhawlta a, gamla kuamtak a Zarethan gam chin a Adam ah ahong kiching hi. Arabah tuipi, Chi Tuipi lam a luangsuk lai akitat geih a; huchi in Jeriko khozawntak ah mipite agalkahta uhi.
Jordan lui lai ah TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng siampute leihul ah adingh ua, mipi tengteng Jordan lui agalkah vek uhi.
